What I searched
- Queried the indexed corpus (docs) for "Amendment No. 1", "Amendment 1", "service credit", and "Master Services Agreement".

Why I couldn't find it
- The file that would contain Amendment No. 1 is contracts/amendment-1-2021.pdf (c:/Users/.../project/docs/contracts/amendment-1-2021.pdf), but the index reported it was refused as encrypted and could not be opened. The query returned a degraded verdict with a parse_gap_in_scope error pointing to that encrypted PDF, so the amendment text (and any service credit percentage it sets) is not readable in the corpus.

Documents checked
- msa-2019.pdf (Master Services Agreement) — searchable and indexed, but it does not contain the Amendment No. 1 service-credit percentage.
- contracts/amendment-1-2021.pdf — present on disk but encrypted/refused, so unreadable by the index.

If you can provide the password or an unencrypted copy of amendment-1-2021.pdf, I can read it and extract the service credit percentage (with the document name and page).
